# Neuromorphic_Spiking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational paradigm where information is processed through discrete spike events in time, mimicking biological neural activity. This is the core signal representation for iNEST, enabling energy-efficient, event-driven computation in network hardware.
